title: FSDAcceleratingWaveforms: Code and numerical data for A Novel Method to Construct Frequency-Domain Gravitational Waveform for Accelerating Sources
description: Reproducible implementation of frequency-domain spectral differentiation waveforms for accelerating compact-binary sources, together with the numerical tables and figures supporting the associated article.
notes: Source code is GPL-3.0-or-later. Archived numerical data and generated figures are CC-BY-4.0.
